patch.summary: Office Timeline implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Office Timeline by mapping current project-management workflows to Office Timeline objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Microsoft Powerpoint, Microsoft Project, Excel) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Microsoft Powerpoint

blocks.heading: Office Timeline day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Office Timeline setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for task boards, timeline / Gantt, docs and collaboration before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves PMO and project leads who need PowerPoint-native executive timelines/Gantt before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Microsoft Powerpoint and Microsoft Project before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management
Do not expand seats until task boards is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Automations and AI assistance are not the product job

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Collaboration is presentation-centric rather than multiplayer work tracking

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Office Timeline plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.
